title: Add shared Claude Code permissions + .env gotcha
body:
## Summary
Adds a shared `.claude/settings.json`, ignores `*.local.json` (personal overrides), and documents that Claude can't read `.env`.

## Permission rules (`.claude/settings.json`)

### allow (no prompt)
| Rule | Why |
|---|---|
| `Bash(npm test -w apps/api *)` | API tests (Vitest, real Postgres); accepts filters, e.g. `-- teams` |
| `Bash(npm run typecheck)` | Project workflow: run after edits instead of full build. Exact match, no wildcard |
| `Bash(npm run lint)` | Read-only check. Exact match, no wildcard |
| `Bash(npm view *)` | Read-only npm registry lookups |
| `mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages` | Read-only: browser console output |
| `mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp` | Read-only: list open tabs |
| `mcp__claude-in-chrome__find` | Read-only: locate page elements |

### ask (always prompts)
| Rule | Why |
|---|---|
| `Bash(git push *)` | Outward-facing, hard to reverse |
| `Bash(gh pr merge *)` | Merges to `main` |
| `Bash(docker compose down *)` | Stops the local Postgres |

### deny (blocked)
| Rule | Why |
|---|---|
| `Read(.env)` | Keep secrets out of the session |
| `Read(.env.*)` | Same, for `.env.local` etc. |
| `Read(!.env.example)` | Re-allows `.env.example` (the template is safe to read) |
| `Bash(npm run db:reset)` | Wipes the DB, re-runs migrations + seed |

Deliberately not allowlisted: `npm run *`, `npx`, `node`, `curl`, `docker exec` (arbitrary execution), anything that writes or pushes.

## Other changes
- `.gitignore`: add `*.local.json` so `.claude/settings.local.json` stays personal.
- `CLAUDE.md` (Gotchas): Claude can't read `.env`; new env vars go in `apps/api/.env.example` and the user copies them.

title: API test harness (Vitest + supertest), citext fix, empty teamId fix
body:
## Summary
- **Test harness**: Vitest + supertest on `createApp()` against a dedicated Postgres `devpulse_test` (globalSetup creates it and runs `migrate deploy`; every table truncated before each test; files run serially). Factories in `apps/api/test/factories.ts`.
- **Bug fix 1**: `githubLogin` / `githubFullName` are now `@db.Citext` (migration `citext_github_names`, creates the extension). The `@unique` index is case-insensitive, so the app-level ILIKE pre-checks in `lib/guards.ts` are gone. This fixes `_` acting as a wildcard (`devpulse/ap_` falsely conflicted with `devpulse/api`).
- **Bug fix 2**: `teamId` in `updateMemberSchema` / `updateRepositorySchema` is `.min(1)`, so `{"teamId":""}` is 400 with a ZodIssue[] instead of a 409 from the FK.
- **smoke.sh replaced**: every smoke check now has a Vitest equivalent, one file per router (+ `app.test.ts`); `scripts/smoke.sh` and the `smoke` npm script are removed. 149 tests, expanded after a spec review (ordering, tiebreaker paging, strict PATCH, 404 messages, duplicate 409s, cascades).
- Docs: `docs/SPEC-rest-api.md` (5.3, 7, 8, 9) and `CLAUDE.md` updated.

## Test plan
- [x] `docker compose up -d`
- [x] `npm test -w apps/api` -> 7 files, 149 tests pass (re-run is idempotent)
- [x] `npm run typecheck` exits 0
- [ ] Reviewer: run the new migration against a dev DB that has real data (see risks)

## Risks / unsure
- **Migration on existing data**: `ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE CITEXT` fails if existing rows already differ only by case (the old check let some race through). Check before applying to a non-empty DB. It also needs the `citext` contrib extension and privileges to `CREATE EXTENSION`.
- **Possible spec/code mismatch (unverified)**: spec 5.1 says body-parser 4xx -> 400 `BAD_REQUEST`, but `errorHandler` returns the error's own status, so an oversized body would likely be 413. Not tested; needs a decision on spec vs code.
- **New tests not mutation-checked**: they passed first run, but I did not confirm each fails against the bug it targets (that needs temporary `src/` changes).
- **Known remaining gaps** (from the second review): CORS/`WEB_ORIGIN`; valid `limit`/`offset` on members and repos lists; Issue/PR DTO field and ISO-date assertions; oversized/no/array body; `P2003`/`P2025`/"Resource already exists" mappings; prod 404 for member/repo/issue/PR; the PR tiebreaker test only checks distinct ids (no ordering); the label test has no `bugfix`/`Bug` fixture; `teamSchema.parse` in the teams test reuses the DTO's schema.
- **Lost coverage**: smoke's server-log-shape check (`level 40`, `reqId`, no stack on 4xx) is not automated (tests run with `LOG_LEVEL=silent`); spec 9 now says to check manually.
- **Env fragility**: tests need Postgres on :5435 up. `vite@^8` is an explicit devDependency because Vitest 5's `vite` peer is skipped under `legacy-peer-deps=true` (which is set in the author's npm config). Vitest 5 wants `@types/node` ^22/>=24; repo has ^20 (typecheck passes). No CI runs the tests yet.
- Prod error shapes are tested via `vi.stubEnv("NODE_ENV","production")`, not a real production server.
- Two sort assertions compare against JS `.sort()` of UUIDs while the DB sorts by its text collation; fine for hex UUIDs, a latent flake if the DB collation changes.

title: Add REST API for teams, members, repositories, issues, PRs
body:
## Summary
Implements `docs/SPEC-rest-api.md` in `apps/api`.

- **Routes:** CRUD for teams/members/repositories; list/get for issues and PRs; `PATCH /issues/:id` (priority only). Lists return `Page<T>` (`limit`/`offset`), with issue/PR filters and sorts (stable via `id` tiebreaker).
- **Shared schemas:** split per model in `packages/shared/src` with named re-exports; strict update schemas, pagination/list query schemas, `apiErrorSchema`.
- **Errors:** `parseInput` + `AppError` types, Prisma P2002/P2003/P2025 mapping (constraint read from `meta.driverAdapterError.cause.constraint.index`). Validation stays `{ error: ZodIssue[] }`; other errors are a string in prod, `{ code, message, stack }` envelope in dev.
- **Logging/CORS:** pino + pino-http JSON logs with `X-Request-Id`; CORS from `WEB_ORIGIN`.
- **DB:** `Member.team` / `Repository.team` FKs -> `Restrict` (migration `team_fk_restrict`); seed deletes children first. Case-insensitive uniqueness for `githubLogin` / `githubFullName` is app-level.
- **Tooling:** `apps/api/scripts/smoke.sh` (`npm run smoke -w apps/api`); `CLAUDE.md` updated.

## Deviations from the spec
- `src/env.ts` loads `apps/api/.env` relative to the file, so the prod command run from the repo root finds `DATABASE_URL`.
- `src/lib/guards.ts` (existence + uniqueness checks), `zod` added to api deps, `packages/shared/src/common.ts` for shared helpers.
- body-parser 4xx errors keep their real status (e.g. 413) with code `BAD_REQUEST`, rather than always 400.
- Smoke script reseeds first (`SKIP_RESEED=1` to disable) since it deletes seed data.

## Test plan
- [x] `npm run typecheck` (root) exits 0
- [x] `npm run smoke -w apps/api` passes in `MODE=dev` and `MODE=prod`
- [x] 4xx log line has `reqId`, `status`, `err`, no `stack` in both modes
- [x] `db:seed` runs twice in a row against populated data
- [ ] `db:reset` not run (blocked by the Prisma AI-action guard); migrations were applied via `migrate dev`
